title_draft: Zad Archery Rings, Portal Currency and Endless Explained
quick_answer_draft: After level 30, Portal Currency feeds the Ring System, which includes 9 Ring perks. The Mega Update also adds Endless farming and removes the Level 50 cap. This page explains those verified systems only; it does not publish a complete Ring ranking or best Endless farming route.

claims.text: Portal Currency is used after level 30.
The Ring System was added in the Mega Update.

sections.h2: Endless and the removed Level 50 cap

claims.text: Automatic currency pickup / progression behavior improved in the same update.
No complete Ring perk ranking or best Endless farming route is published in the verified recovery evidence.
